items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 13 at 3:20PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Moderate snow and winds are expected in the Eastern Brooks Range
from Saturday morning through Saturday night. Total snow
accumulations could range between 2 and 5 inches during this time.
Wind gusts to 35 mph could produce areas of blowing and drifting
snow. Travel may become difficult throughout this period.
items.areas: South Slopes Of The Eastern Brooks Range; Yukon Flats

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 13 at 2:59PM AKST until November 15 at 3:00AM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow and blowing snow expected. Total snow accumulations up
to 2 inches expected. Winds gusting as high as 40 mph.

* WHERE...Central Brooks Range.

* WHEN...From noon Saturday to 3 AM AKST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Snow and blowing snow could
reduce visibility to 1/2 mile at times.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.

items.headline: Blizzard Warning issued November 13 at 2:59PM AKST until November 15 at 7:00AM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Blizzard conditions. Additional snow accumulations up to two
inches. Winds gusting as high as 60 mph.

* WHERE...Northern Arctic Coast.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Snow and blowing snow could
reduce visibility below one half mile at times. Periods of blizzard
conditions will be intermittently possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The lull in snow and wind will continue
through Saturday morning before snowfall chances increase Saturday
afternoon
items.instruction:
Travel should be restricted to emergencies only. If you must travel,
have a winter survival kit with you. If you get stranded, stay with
your vehicle.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 13 at 12:14PM AKST until November 15 at 6:00AM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph expected.

* WHERE...Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...From 6 PM Saturday to 6 AM AKST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will begin to increase during the day
Saturday, reaching at least 45 mph during the evening timeframe.
Forecast confidence is increasing strong wind gusts will then
continue into Sunday.
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.
